reason: Both are building-products manufacturers selling roofing and insulation through contractors and distributors. The products differ: Carlisle's lines are commercial single-ply membranes, polyiso, metal roofing and weatherproofing. Owens Corning's are mainly asphalt shingles, fiberglass insulation and doors, which skew residential. Owens Corning also sells polyiso facers, which are inputs to Carlisle-type products. The overlap is partial on both product and customer, so this is adjacent.
